text:
maria: Heads-up 1: SilverCrest RFI packet needs finalization. I uploaded capability_matrix.csv and rfi_blurb.docx to /deals/silvercrest/rfi. Buyer asks: POC throughput numbers, HSM/KMS options, peering diagram, and three pricing bands (monthly). Can ops/security/finance review asap?

owen: I'll grab HSM/KMS copy. Short FAQ entries we should use: Private = BYO-HSM (PKCS#11) + private control plane option; Dedicated = CMEK/cloud-KMS supported; Hosted = cloud KMS only, no raw key access. Will add note about FIPS/HSM validation.

harper: Ops note: POC throughput varies by model & batch settings. Suggested lines for RFI: `13B: ~400 req/s on 4xA100 (16 tok avg)`; `70B: ~90 req/s on 8xA100 equiv`. Will attach a tiny CSV with assumptions and a one-page runbook pointer.

ryan: Finance: buyer wants bands at 25k/250k/1M tokens/mo + single-month dedicated POC price. I'll back-of-envelope these and post numbers later today. Also theyre asking about cancellation for POC and liability cap.

compliance-bot: Reminder: SilverCrest RFI due 2025-04-05 18:00 UTC. Upload final files to /deals/silvercrest/rfi/FINAL for audit.

owen: Draft HSM blurb (paste):

"Private deployment: supports customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11/NSS with an integration guide and recommended attestation steps. Dedicated: supports cloud KMS (CMEK) with customer key ownership. Hosted: integrates with provider KMS only; we do not access or persist raw key material. For customers requiring FIPS 140-2/3 validated HSMs, Private deployment is recommended."

harper: CSV (paste):

```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_s,burst_reqs_s,assumptions
sc-13b,4xA100,400,700,16 token avg, warmed cache
sc-70b,8xA100,90,160,16 token avg, large-context opts
embed-pro,2xA100,1100,1800,embedding-only workload
```

maria: FYI buyer flagged two blockers: legal wants a proposed egress cap; infra wants a POC->prod runbook. Who owns runbook?

harper: Ops will draft a 1-2 page runbook (warming steps, autoscale toggles, metrics to monitor). I'll drop a draft by EOD.

owen: Also adding a short FedRAMP mapping note to the security section.

ryan: I'll post pricing bands by 3pm. Tentative: hosted base X, dedicated +20%, POC-month flat fee $12k (subject to legal).

maria: Action list: owen finalize security + FedRAMP mapping (due Wed EOD); harper upload runbook + throughput CSV (due Wed noon); ryan post pricing bands and cancellation language (due Wed 3pm). I'll assemble final RFI and trigger internal sign-off.

owen: Quick ask 1: when we call out fallback behavior (if Dedicated saturated) do we mark it as SLA-impacting caveat in matrix?

harper: Yes mark as caveat. We'll say: "Fallback to compatible variant may change latency SLA."

maria: perfect. tagging the thread for final sign-off tomorrow 09:30. Post blockers here.
